title: Light and Its Properties
description: Explore how light helps us see, identify luminous and non-luminous objects, and investigate how light travels, passes through materials, and forms shadows.

title: Comparing Decimal Numbers
description: Drag and drop to compare decimals using place value — students build intuition for number magnitude through hands-on manipulation.

title: Parallel & Series Circuits
description: Add and remove bulbs to explore how brightness changes in parallel vs series circuits — misconception-busting physics made tangible.

title: Biology Lab Safety: Spot the Contamination Risks
description: Identify three contamination risks in a lab setup to prevent sample integrity issues — interactive risk assessment through visual inspection and feedback.

title: Equivalent Fractions: Clay Block Exploration
description: Divide clay blocks into equal parts and discover that different fractions can represent the same value — hands-on visual learning of fraction equivalence.

title: Comparing Fractions Visually
description: Use chocolate-bar models to compare fractions side by side — students build intuition for fraction size through hands-on visual manipulation.

title: Fractions – Interactive Digital Book
description: A page-flip digital book covering CBSE Class 5 fractions, with embedded hotspots that open the Comparing Fractions and Chocolate Fractions applets directly from the relevant pages.

title: Surface Area of a Cylinder – Interactive Digital Book
description: A page-flip digital book covering CBSE Class 8 surface area of cylinders, with an embedded interactive applet that lets students explore the net of a cylinder and derive the formula step by step.

title: Boojho's Chocolate Sharing – Equivalent Fractions
description: Step-by-step visual exploration where students shade and split chocolate-bar wholes to discover that 1/2 = 2/4 and 1/3 = 2/6 — building a concrete understanding of equivalent fractions through guided interaction.

title: Modifiers: Word, Phrase or Clause?
description: Drag "only" through a sentence to see one word change its meaning, then classify modifiers as a word, phrase, or clause across ten practice sentences — built for UPSC and competitive-exam English grammar.

title: Misplaced Modifiers
description: Choose what "almost" should modify, then drag misplaced modifiers next to the word they actually describe across eight practice sentences — built for UPSC and competitive-exam English grammar.

title: Modifiers – Interactive Digital Book
description: A page-flip digital book covering Chapter 1 of the UPSC Grammar Blueprint, with embedded hotspots that open the Modifiers and Misplaced Modifiers applets directly from the relevant pages.

title: Orienting Yourself – Locating Points on a Floor Plan
description: Students drag pins onto a floor plan of a room, then watch the marked positions resolve into a labelled grid — building the intuition that a grid lets us describe any location with numbers.

title: The 2-D Cartesian Coordinate System
description: An interactive tour of the coordinate plane: the x- and y-axes, their positive and negative directions, the origin, and how an ordered pair (x, y) pins down any point.

title: Finding Distances with Coordinates
description: Students read coordinates off a scaled room plan to work out door widths by subtracting x- and y-values, then compare the result against real-world wheelchair accessibility.

title: Quadrants of the Cartesian Plane
description: Build the plane axis by axis, discover the four quadrants and their anti-clockwise numbering, then plot points by dragging — learning the sign pattern of each quadrant by doing.

title: The Distance Formula – Pythagoras in Coordinates
description: Starting from horizontal and vertical distances, students build a right triangle on a slanted segment and derive the distance formula as Pythagoras' theorem written in coordinates.
